verdict.rationale: Antigravity's docs describe an agent that operates via natural-language commands across editor/terminal/browser, can delegate to subagents for running tests and codebase searches, and works within artifacts/plans that could support troubleshooting workflows, but no documentation explicitly frames a 'debug via NL query' feature and no hands-on evidence confirms debugging effectiveness. Some community reports note general harness/model quality issues that indirectly cast doubt on complex reasoning tasks like debugging. Missing for 10: explicit debugging/troubleshooting feature documentation, independent hands-on validation of debugging accuracy, and structured error-analysis or log-inspection capability.
